# DragonSword Guide

> Independent fan reference for DragonSword: Awakening (Hound13 Inc., released 2026-07-22).
> Every guide lists the sources it was verified against. Anything not confirmed is
> marked "still to verify" rather than guessed.

## Game facts
- Name: DragonSword: Awakening
- Developer / Publisher: Hound13 Inc. / Hound13 Inc.
- Release date: 2026-07-22
- Platforms: Windows
- Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG
- Official store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720/

## Sections
- https://dragonsword.site/guides/ — Beginner route, combat systems, cooking and PC setup.
- https://dragonsword.site/heroes/ — All 19 playable Heroes and how their ailments combine.

## Editorial policy
This site does not publish item values, boss mechanics, or names it has not verified.
Pages with unverified areas say so explicitly in a "still to verify" section.
